description: Jube case workflow that carries the Vati case lifecycle (TAX-034). Jube owns the case and its status; each Jube status name maps to the Vati CaseStatus projection in integration/api/openapi.json. Reviewed in Git; provisioned with scripts/jube_cases.py.

jube_tenant.name: Vati synthetic (local)
jube_tenant.description: Non-landlord Jube tenant for Vati synthetic cases. Landlord-tenant users bypass every Jube permission, so Vati identities never live in the landlord tenant.

workflow.name: Vati tax case lifecycle v1
workflow.description: Synthetic Vati tax review cases; one case per Vati case_id. Case key CaseId is the risk model entry name: Jube archives invocations keyed by entry name.
